City Council/Public Financing Authority  City of Huntington Beach
Tuesday, April 18, 2023  2000 Main Street
6:00 PM - Regular Meeting  Huntington Beach, CA 92648
AGENDA  Council Chambers

  MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL
AL ZELINKA, City Manager  TONY STRICKLAND, Mayor
MICHAEL E. GATES, City Attorney  GRACEY VAN DER MARK, Mayor Pro Tem
ROBIN ESTANISLAU, City Clerk  RHONDA BOLTON, Councilmember
ALISA BACKSTROM, City Treasurer  PAT BURNS, Councilmember
  DAN KALMICK, Councilmember
  CASEY McKEON, Councilmember
  NATALIE MOSER, Councilmember

  NOTICE OF CANCELLATION

Due to a lack of quorum, the City Council/Public Financing Authority regular meeting of
Tuesday, April 18, 2023, has been CANCELLED.

NOTE: A public hearing scheduled for April 18 on the 2023-2024 Annual Action Plan for
Federal Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) and Home Investment Partnerships
(HOME) Entitlement Grant Programs and an Amendment (Substantial) to the 2020/21-2024/25
Citizen Participation Plan, will be re-noticed to occur at the City Council/Public Financing
Authority's next regular meeting of Tuesday, May 2, 2023 at 6:00 PM, Civic Center,
2000 Main Street.
